edges.mechanism: Same NAD+ salvage/Preiss-Handler route; NR and NMN raise blood NAD+ comparably, largely via gut-microbial conversion to nicotinic acid. Stacking duplicates effect and adds nicotinamide/methyl-group load without evidence of additive benefit.
edges.evidence: Head-to-head human RCT (n=65); mouse tracer study; review of high-dose nicotinamide risks; no combination trial

edges.mechanism: Excess nicotinamide is cleared by NNMT using SAM; in rats nicotinamide loading lowered betaine and hepatic DNA methylation. Betaine remethylates homocysteine, providing a rationale for co-supplementation. Human NR trials show only a transient homocysteine rise with intact methyl pool.
edges.evidence: Rat and biochemical studies plus human NR RCTs; no NMN+TMG trial; theoretical

edges.mechanism: Proposed complementary action on the NAD+/SIRT1 axis (precursor supply plus sirtuin activation). The analogous stilbene pterostilbene combined with NR raised NAD+ safely in RCTs.
edges.evidence: Review rationale; NR+pterostilbene RCTs; no NMN+resveratrol human data; very low certainty

edges.mechanism: Metformin inhibits complex I and raises the NADH/NAD+ ratio; NMN reversed NAD-depletion-dependent metformin effects (synthetic lethality, reduced migration) in cancer cells. NMN has no pooled glycaemic effect, so additive hypoglycaemia is unlikely.
edges.evidence: In-vitro cancer-cell studies; MA of NMN RCTs for glycaemia; no human interaction study

edges.mechanism: Additive nicotinamide (niacin) intake: 300 mg NMN corresponds to ~110 mg nicotinamide (about 5x PRI) versus a 900 mg/d nicotinamide UL.

NAD+ precursors improved mitochondrial function and reduced DNA damage/apoptosis in pancreatic cancer cells, conferring resistance to oxaliplatin, 5-FU and gemcitabine in vitro and in mice; in other models NMN did not impair chemotherapy and protected ovaries/heart from toxicity.
edges.evidence: Conflicting preclinical data only; no human interaction data

edges.with: NAMPT inhibitors and NAD-depleting anticancer strategies
edges.mechanism: These agents work by starving tumours of NAD+; exogenous NAD+ precursors that bypass NAMPT (or feed NAPRT/Preiss-Handler) would be expected to rescue tumour NAD+ and antagonize them.
edges.evidence: Mechanistic reviews and myeloma translational study; theoretical for NMN

edges.mechanism: Tumours depend on elevated NAD+; NMN supported pancreatic tumour growth in mice, while other models show tumour suppression and lifelong NMN did not raise tumour burden in mice. Direction is tumour-specific and unknown in humans.
edges.evidence: Preclinical studies and reviews; very low certainty

edges.mechanism: No human safety data; EFSA restricted its positive safety conclusion to adults excluding pregnant and lactating women; rat NOAEL based on reproductive-organ effects.
In aged (not young) mice NMN increased circulating uremic toxins and kidney inflammation/tubule injury markers; in COVID-19 AKI, 2 g/d MIB-626 was safe but did not improve kidney markers.
edges.evidence: Preprint mouse study; small RCT; DKD trial ongoing

edges.mechanism: NMN and NR improved lipids and fatty liver yet aggravated atherosclerosis dose-dependently in ApoE-/- mice.
edges.evidence: Single mouse study; no human signal

edges.mechanism: NMN is catabolized to nicotinamide; direct nicotinamide (500-1000 mg/d) caused thrombocytopenia in hemodialysis RCTs. Not observed with NMN, which raised platelets in ITP.
edges.evidence: Extrapolation from nicotinamide RCTs and SR

edges.mechanism: NMN modestly lowers diastolic blood pressure (WMD -2.15 mmHg; -7 mmHg with 2 g/d MIB-626), so a small additive effect is possible.
edges.evidence: MA of 10 RCTs and one RCT; low certainty

edges.mechanism: NMN 1200 mg/d abolished the acute rise in muscle mitochondrial content after blood-flow-restriction resistance exercise while suppressing inflammatory signalling; conversely it improved ventilatory-threshold power with endurance training.
edges.evidence: Small crossover RCT (n=11) and RCT in runners (n=48)

edges.mechanism: NMN dose-dependently raises methylnicotinamide and pyridone catabolites, so niacin-status biomarkers reflect supplement intake.
Within-normal-range shifts after NMN: bilirubin up and creatinine down after single doses; NAD rise associated with higher haemoglobin, RBC and uric acid.
edges.evidence: Single-arm study and post hoc RCT analysis

edges.mechanism: Theoretical methyl-donor drain from nicotinamide methylation; NR trial found no DNA-methylation disturbance including in MTHFR variant carriers.
edges.evidence: One RCT with NR (n=29); no NMN data
